comment: The hyphenation pattern files the UI fetches on first use and hands to cdoc-wasm through the font port (EditorFonts.addPatterns / RenderAssets.addPatterns, by tag). Each is unmodified from hyph-utf8 with its licence header intact; the tags are cdoc_para::Language::tag, and a test checks they agree. hyphenation_patterns_needed(modelJson) names the tags a document needs; a language with no file registered is not hyphenated.
